page.overview:
Who is Aku-Shin Kage?

Aku-Shin Kage (悪心影, meaning "malicious shadow" and with alternate spelling "Akushin Kage", "Aku-Shin-Kage" or "Akushin-Kage") is one of the avatars of Nyarlathotep. Its first appearance was in the Secrets of Japan supplement for the Call of Cthulhu role-playing game.

Aku-Shin Kage's field of action is the territory of Japan. Throughout the history of the country, it has caused many wars and confrontations. In fact, it is believed that the warlord Oda Nobunaga was one of the Aku-Shin Kage's human incarnations known as the "Dark Warlord".

Dark Warlord is said to have dictated the work known as "Kuragari no shūkai" (in English, "Manual of the Shadows") to a ninja clan with supernatural powers that carried out a multitude of killings and served the Dark Warlord from the late 12th century to the early 18th century.

In more modern times, due to a long and close affinity with Oda in life, it can take on the human form of the ghost of Nobunaga, appearing age 40. In this guise, the avatar of Nyarlathotep urges on one or more deranged leaders of ultra-right nationalist groups. Nowadays, it resembles a Yotsubishi Heavy Industries businessman advocating a golden age for the Japanese empire in boardrooms.
